descriptions.w3d_s20_dispatch_kind_801a42fc: Appears to run a helper for flagged items, then call the handler selected by a global's kind bits from the table at offset 24.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_block_and_forward_801a5650: Appears to copy a 24-byte block into the object at offset 60 and pass it with the range at offset 44 to a helper, returning zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_construct_with_global_801c98b8: Appears to run a base constructor, install a vtable, retain a global shared object, clear two fields and return this.
descriptions.w3d_s20_warn_if_empty_801d66d8: Appears to log a warning for the secondary base subobject when the item's record is empty, then forward this and the item.
